publicBoundary.title: Post not found | ColinMichaels.com
publicBoundary.interpretation: The proposed canonical is not a public article, is excluded from indexing, is absent from the sitemap, and has no anonymously queryable published Firestore record with the same slug. These checks establish the public collision boundary only; they do not prove that a protected draft with another document ID is absent.

firestoreBoundary.interpretation: Anonymous direct-document inspection is denied by the production rules. A 403 is not evidence that the draft ID is unreserved. The protected importer must perform its normal trusted slug and document-ID reservation checks before any save.
